trust_boundaries.assumption: Child proofs are produced by the wallet (or by the node on the demo path) and re-verified in-circuit with a verifier retained by the node.

trust_boundaries.assumption: Submitter-token holders post SPHINCS+ envelopes; admin holds demo prover and settlement.

verified_findings.summary: On-chain settlement verifier is not bound to the block circuit: CONFIG (verifying-key digest, WHIR schedules, constraint programs) is read from the caller-supplied bundle and never pinned; applyBlock is permissionless. PoC: forge test applies a proof of a constraint-free circuit and rewrites both pool roots. (was F-01)

WHIR per-matrix opening points are taken from the bundle STATEMENT section and never tied to the transcript zeta, while the constraint identity is evaluated at zeta. Experiment: an opening point in the real block bundle was changed to z'!=zeta and verify() still returned true. (was F-02)

Each opening round's WHIR commitment (root) is read from PROOF and never compared with the trace/quotient/preprocessed/permutation digests absorbed in the batch transcript, so a prover may open freshly-committed (incl. preprocessed/fixed) columns after zeta is known. Structural + honest-bundle + junk-root experiment. (was F-03)

Pruned QFOLD/MROOTS query walk de-duplicates repeated query indices without checking the duplicate rows agree (p3 rejects InconsistentDuplicateOpenings). Experiment: depth-2 tree with indices [1,1] accepts mismatched rows. (was F-04)

LogUp terminal count is proof-chosen; the terminal-sum check and transcript absorb all terminals but the constraint identity consumes only the first #hasTerminal, with no tIdx==nTerm check, so appended compensating terminals defeat the sum-zero check. Experiment on satellite code. (was F-05)

Block circuit verifies child proofs against a client-supplied verifier object and never pins the child preprocessed commitment (child VK) in the recursion circuit; per-transfer data is baked as preprocessed constants, so no canonical child VK exists and a same-shape child of any relation is accepted. Survives a CONFIG pin. (B-01 = C-01)

In-circuit Poseidon2 sponge is not a function of its input on the shared D4 table: the chain-start capacity (IV) is unconstrained for ordinary sponge rows and the partial final-chunk carry coefficients are unbound, so nullifiers are malleable and one note can be re-spent without limit. (B-02)

Binary Merkle paths in the Poseidon2 circuit AIR bind neither the leaf digest nor the direction bits (mmcs_index_sum always None; input-limb sends zeroed on Merkle rows; first path row new_start), making every in-circuit WHIR query/opening check vacuous. Upstream defect, reachable on the WHIR (binary) path. (C-02)

high.summary: Permissionless applyBlock plus no on-chain data availability (only roots+fee are emitted; per-transfer nullifiers/commitments and statementRoot never reach L1). A party that settles a block it does not share freezes the pool and the operator node permanently. PoC: forge test, arbitrary sender applies, event carries 5 words. (D01; F-10)

Output-note append position is a free witness (frontier count/bits unbound; zero leaf == empty leaf), so a prover can append at an arbitrary index and permanently freeze the commitment tree / desync an honest node. (B-03)

Client transfer verifier/VK embeds the spent-note membership siblings (position) and recipient pk_d as preprocessed constants; the unblinded preprocessed commitment handed to the sequencer reveals which note is spent and the recipient. (B-04)

medium.summary: Cross-pool / cross-chain replay: block statement and spend-auth message carry no chain id or pool address; the same (statement,proof) settles on any pool at the same genesis. PoC: forge test applies one block to two pools. (D05; F-10)

SPHINCS+ spend-authorization envelope is not bound to the note, proof, or identity (verifying key is self-supplied) and is verified only natively, never in-circuit or on-chain; authorization reduces to in-circuit knowledge of sk_d. (B-12 = D02)

Statement aliasing: _checkStatement accepts statement[i] congruent mod p to the proof's public values; unchecked header positions feed the AIR a value chosen after all challenges (ConstraintIdentityMismatch divergence shown). Also one proof verifies for many statement arrays. (F-06)

Proof extension-field elements are not range-checked; the transcript reduces lanes mod p while KoalaBearExt4 add/sub carry across lanes, so two distinct byte strings verify as the same proof (malleability shown) and transcript vs arithmetic disagree. (F-07)
WHIR shape (sumcheck round counts, final-poly length, initial OOD count, bound-eval counts) is taken from proof array lengths rather than CONFIG; several p3 shape checks are absent. (F-08)

Node block pipeline is not atomic: a transient prove/IO/RPC failure drops the drained batch and leaves the projection drifted, wedging the node (single pending-settlement slot, in-memory state). (D04)
HVZK budget check is pooled over the batch and does not enforce per-column hiding; tables with fewer rows than D*points leak witness dimensions; native hiding-WHIR not used. (M-01/agent C)
Faerie gold: nullifier nf=H(sk_d||rho) is not position-bound and output rho is a free witness; two notes to a recipient with equal rho share one nullifier, making one unspendable. (B-05)
Nullifier absence fold starts at height 64; any spent nullifier sharing the low-96-bit tail makes a note permanently unspendable (and native NullifierMap mishandles such collisions). (B-06/B-09)
Settlement proof is non-ZK (since a54c197) yet the recursion witness holds child proofs, child preprocessed openings (linear in secrets) and full child statements; leakage not quantified. (B-07)
Shared rate-limiter bucket keyed by (role,path): one low-privilege token holder starves every other client of that role; unauthenticated traffic unlimited. (D06)

low.summary: SealedVault::from_bytes indexes attacker-controlled length fields without bounds checks, panicking on crafted vault bytes. (D07)
insecure-stub signing feature lacks the claimed release guard; a --release --features insecure-stub build compiles (unreached today). (D09)
Token hygiene: no max TTL / overflow, base64url decoder accepts non-canonical trailing bits (token malleable), 1-byte key-file accepted, no revocation route, deterministic in (role,expiry). (D11)
Statement completeness / DA: statementRoot has no L1 consumer; users cannot rebuild the tree or prove inclusion without the sequencer. (B-08/D15)
Block header split validated only by sum (shape (2,0) accepted for a (1,1) child); fold_membership path length unchecked. (B-10/B-11)
wallet-wasm zeroization gaps (password/vault copies, sk_d arrays); write_private follows a planted <path>.tmp symlink and writes before the target-type check. (D10/D12)
R randomization commitment adds no hiding to the trace opening despite the patch doc claim; upstream ZK guard removed without support/tests. (L-01/L-02 agent C)
SLH-DSA parameter rationale wrong (128f vs 128s cost, 8KB vs 17KB signature, vk 32 not 64 bytes); slh-dsa 0.2.0-rc.5 is a pre-release with TODO context-processing. (D08/D13)

info.summary: Security-relevant env knobs read in library code: WHIR_SECURITY_LEVEL, *_SOUNDNESS_REGIME, *_POW_FLOOR, WHIR_INNER_RATE, WHIR_FINAL_LDE. (B-13/F-10)

Documentation drift: README/comments say SHA3/Keccak notes+nullifiers and an operator set and a keccak depth-256 empty root; code uses Poseidon2 depth-96, permissionless applyBlock. PATCHES.md omits 4 of 5 vendored code changes and misdescribes the ZK patch (no pristine dir, no truncation). (B-13/D20/agent C)
Production node binary built with prover 'testkit' feature, so genesis notes are owned by public fixture keys; demo genesis + SPHINCS+ keys are public fixtures. (D21/B-13)
Fees are burned in-circuit; the fee-recipient role and withdrawFees are vestigial (no payable path). (D16/F-10)
Verification costs ~102M gas, above L1 block limits; GAS_LIMIT=20e9 in the submitter is above every public chain limit; no RPC timeout/TLS, one-receipt finality. (F-10/D17)
Spent-nullifier oracle: /v1/transfer reports 'already spent' for any self-signed nullifier, exposing spent-set membership to Submitters. (D19)

In-circuit: 0-bit PoW leaves the witness unconstrained (malleability); circuit query-index low-bits vs native rejection-sampling diverge at p-1 (completeness); batch verifier omits check_multiplicity_height_bound. (I-02..I-04 agent C)
